hunks.baseline: The young man who had been frozen with his eyes wide open—or rather, Ju Wongong—asked in a trembling voice,
hunks.sol: The young man who had frozen with his eyes wide—or rather, Ju Wongong—asked in a trembling voice,

hunks.baseline: Had this bastard’s ears been plugged since earlier? He kept making me repeat myself.
hunks.sol: Had this bastard’s ears been plugged this whole time? He kept making me repeat myself.

hunks.baseline: “Whether you’re the main character or Ju Wongong, get down.”
hunks.sol: “Main character, Ju Wongong, whatever. Get down.”

hunks.baseline: “Though you are ultimately a subject of the Great Nation, how dare you show such disrespect to me, a member of His Majesty the Emperor’s bloodline?”
hunks.sol: “You are a subject of the Great Nation! How dare you show such disrespect to a member of His Majesty the Emperor’s own bloodline?”

hunks.baseline: “I have a friend named Johnson. If he were here, he would have violated something else.”
hunks.sol: “I have a friend named Johnson. If he were here, he’d have violated something else.”

hunks.baseline: Though he had no idea what I meant, anyone could sense danger.
hunks.sol: He had no idea what I meant, but anyone with human instincts could sense danger.

hunks.baseline: Ju Wongong’s butt twitched instinctively, and he slowly rose to his feet.
hunks.sol: Ju Wongong’s butt twitched, and he slowly rose to his feet.

hunks.baseline: Yet even as his eyes darted about anxiously at a situation he had never experienced before, he did not forget to issue threats until the very end. Perhaps he trusted in his imperial background.
hunks.sol: Yet even as his eyes darted around in anxiety at this unprecedented situation, he didn’t forget to threaten me until the bitter end. Apparently, he still trusted his imperial pedigree to protect him.

hunks.baseline: Although I answered casually, I was not entirely wrong.
hunks.sol: I answered casually, but he wasn’t entirely wrong.

hunks.baseline: The imperial family possessed the same Zhu surname as the Son of Heaven and carried the blood of dragons. That alone made them noble.
hunks.sol: The imperial family bore the same Zhu surname as the Son of Heaven and carried the blood of dragons. That alone made them noble.

hunks.baseline: Even though the Murim and the government maintained a relationship of mutual noninterference, disrespecting or threatening an imperial relative was treated as a serious crime.
hunks.sol: Even though Murim and the government maintained a relationship of mutual noninterference, disrespecting or threatening an imperial relative was treated as a serious crime.

hunks.baseline: That was why the Zhuge Clan retainer had been groaning like a dog that needed to relieve itself.
hunks.sol: There was a reason the Zhuge Clan retainer had been whining like a dog desperate to relieve itself.

hunks.baseline: I frowned at the retainer’s whisper.
hunks.sol: I frowned at his whisper.

hunks.baseline: “What did I do? I didn’t swear at him, and I didn’t threaten to kill him. He even attacked first. All I did was tell him to get down from the four-person sedan chair.”
hunks.sol: “What did I do? I didn’t swear at him or threaten to kill him. His side even attacked first. All I did was tell him to get down from the four-person sedan chair.”

hunks.baseline: “……Well, that is true when you look at it that way. But he is an imperial relative.”
hunks.sol: “……Well, if you put it that way, you’re right. But he is still an imperial relative.”

hunks.baseline: “Imperial relatives come in all grades. If he’s an eighth-degree relative, doesn’t that mean he isn’t really related by blood, but merely has a few drops of blood somewhere in common? If I spit into the Yangtze right now, the Yangtze and I would probably be about eighth-degree relatives.”
hunks.sol: “Imperial relatives come in all grades. If he’s eight degrees removed, he’s not really a blood relative. They just have a few drops of blood in common. If I spat into the Yangtze right now, the river and I would probably be about eight degrees apart too.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s all right. I spoke quietly, so no one could have heard us anyway.”
hunks.sol: “It’s fine. I said it quietly, so no one could’ve heard us anyway.”

hunks.baseline: At that moment, Ju Wongong, who had misunderstood our whispering, shouted in a triumphant voice,
hunks.sol: At that moment, Ju Wongong misread our whispering and shouted triumphantly.

hunks.baseline: “It seems you have finally grasped the gravity of the situation. But it is already too late. The imperial court’s hundred thousand troops will soon be dispatched to exterminate the nine branches of your kin, along with all other traitors!”
hunks.sol: “It seems you have finally grasped the gravity of the situation. But it is already too late! The imperial court will soon dispatch a hundred thousand troops to exterminate the nine branches of your kin, along with those of every other traitor!”

hunks.baseline: “What have you been saying this whole time, you traitorous bastard?”
hunks.sol: “What have you been babbling about this whole time, you traitorous bastard?”

hunks.baseline: When unmistakable fury appeared in Ju Wongong’s eyes, the commoners swallowed their breaths and prostrated themselves on the ground. Some had already begun fleeing in every direction.
hunks.sol: When unmistakable fury filled Ju Wongong’s eyes, the commoners sucked in their breaths and threw themselves flat on the ground. Some had already begun fleeing in every direction.

hunks.baseline: They seemed intent on avoiding involvement in a needless incident. That meant fewer eyes watching us, so I had no complaints.
hunks.sol: They seemed eager to avoid being dragged into someone else’s trouble. That meant fewer eyes watching us, so I had no complaints.

hunks.baseline: *They keep threatening people with the nine branches of their kin whenever they get bored.*
hunks.sol: *These people threaten to exterminate nine branches of your family whenever they get the chance.*

hunks.baseline: “Do not be too frightened. His talk of a hundred thousand troops is only a bluff.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t be too frightened. His talk of a hundred thousand troops is only a bluff.”

hunks.baseline: “Master Ju was exiled for embezzling a fortune while throwing around his imperial authority. He has no intention of escalating the matter. So please apologize and withdraw at an appropriate point.”
hunks.sol: “Master Ju was exiled for using his imperial authority to embezzle a fortune, so he won’t want to make this matter any bigger. Please apologize and withdraw while you still can.”

hunks.baseline: “He is an imperial relative. No matter how distant his branch may be, his blood cannot be ignored. Besides, he is a distant branch with no chance of inheriting the throne, so even when he commits a crime, they allow him to enjoy a certain amount of special treatment.”
hunks.sol: “He is still an imperial relative. No matter how distant the branch, his blood cannot be ignored. Besides, he is so far removed from the line of succession that even when he commits a crime, they allow him a certain degree of comfort.”

hunks.baseline: “In short, he’s such a fucking nobody that no one around him even bothers with him?”
hunks.sol: “In short, he’s such a fucking nobody that no one even bothers worrying about him?”

hunks.baseline: I let the retainer’s complaint go in one ear and out the other, then gave a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: I let the retainer’s complaint go in one ear and out the other, then laughed quietly.

hunks.baseline: I had wondered why someone who was supposedly an imperial relative was socializing with a gang of thugs on a main road in Hubei rather than staying in the imperial palace. He was even more insignificant than I had imagined.
hunks.sol: I had wondered why someone who was supposedly an imperial relative was hanging around with a gang of thugs on a main road in Hubei instead of living in the imperial palace. It turned out he was even less important than I had imagined.

hunks.baseline: Though I had already guessed as much when he started talking about being an eighth-degree relative.
hunks.sol: Though I had already suspected as much when he started talking about being eight degrees removed.

hunks.baseline: “First, I shall gouge out those arrogant eyeballs of yours for failing to recognize this noble self, then tear you limb from limb, and afterward—”
hunks.sol: “First, I shall gouge out those arrogant eyes of yours for failing to recognize this noble self. Then I shall tear you limb from limb, and afterward—”

hunks.baseline: “Yeah, yeah, I get it. Let’s talk about the rest after you look at this.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah, yeah. I get it. Look at this first, then we can talk about the rest.”

hunks.baseline: I threw an object from inside my robe at Ju Wongong as he delivered his long speech.
hunks.sol: I pulled something from inside my robe and tossed it at Ju Wongong as he delivered his grand speech.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the man who had been puffing out his chest flailed both arms and sat down hard.
hunks.sol: The bastard had been standing there with his chest puffed out, but now he flailed both arms and fell backward onto his ass.

hunks.baseline: “It’s a hidden weapon! A hidden weapon! This bastard is attempting to assassinate an imperial relative!”
hunks.sol: “A hidden weapon! A hidden weapon! This bastard is trying to assassinate an imperial relative!”

hunks.baseline: “……Your level is truly something else.”
hunks.sol: “……You really are something else.”

hunks.baseline: And then.
hunks.sol: And then—

hunks.baseline: The “hidden weapon” landed with a soft clack in front of Ju Wongong’s feet, scattering a brilliant light beneath everyone’s gaze.
hunks.sol: The “hidden weapon” landed with a soft clack in front of Ju Wongong’s feet, gleaming brilliantly beneath everyone’s gaze.

hunks.baseline: Ju Wongong stared at the object before his feet with a puzzled look, then opened his mouth blankly.
hunks.sol: Ju Wongong stared at the object with puzzled eyes, his mouth hanging open.

hunks.baseline: “Huh? Huh? Huhhhhhh?”
hunks.sol: “Huh? Huh? Huhhhhhh!”

hunks.baseline: It did not take long for his question marks to become exclamation marks, or for his anger to turn into shock.
hunks.sol: It didn’t take long for his question marks to become exclamation marks, or for his anger to turn to shock.

hunks.baseline: He looked back and forth between me and the token of Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao, engraved with clouds and a dragon. Then he spoke heavily.
hunks.sol: He looked back and forth between me and Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao’s token, engraved with clouds and a dragon. Then he spoke in a grave voice.

hunks.baseline: Ju Wongong nodded energetically at my gentle voice.
hunks.sol: Ju Wongong nodded vigorously at my gentle tone.

hunks.baseline: The decorative showpieces from Qingxia Hall whom he had hired were keeping people quiet alongside the government troops, who had arrived late. Meanwhile, Cheongpung, who had somehow succeeded in buying dumplings in bulk, opened his eyes wide at the mention of Dongting Lake.
hunks.sol: The decorative showpieces from Qingxia Hall whom he had hired were warning people to keep their mouths shut alongside the government troops, who had arrived late. Meanwhile, Cheongpung, who had somehow succeeded in buying dumplings in bulk, opened his eyes wide at the mention of Dongting Lake.

hunks.baseline: Ju Wongong had finally learned the identity of this dumpling ghost. His uneasy gaze flicked toward the sword hanging at Cheongpung’s waist.
hunks.sol: Now that Ju Wongong knew the identity of this dumpling ghost, he glanced uneasily at the sword hanging from Cheongpung’s waist.

hunks.baseline: “Do you often misunderstand things in your daily life? You attacked people who were trying to pass peacefully, so it would seem that way.”
hunks.sol: “Do you misunderstand things this often? Considering you attacked people who were trying to pass by peacefully, it certainly seems that way.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, I see. If I hadn’t had the token, you would have brought a hundred thousand troops to exterminate my nine branches of kin, gouged out my eyes, and dismembered me?”
hunks.sol: “Oh, I see. So if I hadn’t had the token, you would’ve brought a hundred thousand troops to exterminate nine branches of my family, gouged out my eyes, and torn me limb from limb?”

hunks.baseline: *I didn’t know the token would have this much power, either.*
hunks.sol: *I didn’t know the token would have this much power either.*

hunks.baseline: There was a reason Ju Wongong was being so humble.
hunks.sol: There was a reason Ju Wongong had become so submissive.

hunks.baseline: Even animals distinguished between purebred and mixed-breed. How much more would the imperial family—the most noble bloodline in the world—care about such distinctions?
hunks.sol: Even animals were judged as purebred or mixed-breed. How much more would the imperial family—the noblest bloodline in the world—care about such distinctions?

hunks.baseline: Even though the same imperial blood ran in their veins, Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao was the Son of Heaven’s only younger full brother and the sole prince he had personally appointed.
hunks.sol: Though the same imperial blood ran through their veins, Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao was the Son of Heaven’s one and only full brother and the only vassal prince the Emperor had personally appointed.

hunks.baseline: After the late Emperor’s death, the ruthless Emperor eliminated countless blood relatives in the struggle for the throne. Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao was that ruthless Emperor’s one soft spot.
hunks.sol: After the late Emperor’s death, the ruthless man who now sat upon the throne had eliminated countless blood relatives in the struggle for succession. Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao was that ruthless Emperor’s one soft spot.

hunks.baseline: Ju Wongong, on the other hand, was an imperial relative from a branch eight degrees removed.
hunks.sol: Ju Wongong, on the other hand, came from a collateral branch eight degrees removed.

hunks.baseline: The direct imperial line possessed legitimacy and authority. Even by counting degrees of kinship, Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao was a distant and exalted elder of the household to Ju Wongong.
hunks.sol: The direct imperial line possessed legitimacy and authority. Even by degrees of kinship, Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao was an exalted elder of the family, far beyond Ju Wongong’s reach.

hunks.baseline: Defeat barbarians with barbarians, and defeat a weak Celestial Dragon with a strong Celestial Dragon.
hunks.sol: Defeat barbarians with barbarians, and a weak Celestial Dragon with a strong Celestial Dragon.

hunks.baseline: The chairman of my fan club was this formidable. The more I thought about it, the more my chest swelled with pride.
hunks.sol: The chairman of my fan club was this formidable. Just thinking about it made my heart swell.

hunks.baseline: “W-well, the weather is nice, so I thought I would take a boat ride…”
hunks.sol: “W-well, the weather is pleasant, so I thought I might go boating…”

hunks.baseline: At the unimpressed expression on my face, Ju Wongong hurriedly corrected himself.
hunks.sol: At my incredulous expression, Ju Wongong hurriedly corrected himself.

hunks.baseline: “I intended to take a boat ride while also checking on the people’s welfare, since I heard the mood in Hubei Province has been rather grim lately.”
hunks.sol: “I intended to go boating while also inspecting the people’s welfare, since I heard the mood in Hubei Province has been rather grim lately.”

hunks.baseline: “And you brought all these people along for a boat ride? In times like these?”
hunks.sol: “And you brought all these people along for a boat ride? At a time like this?”

hunks.baseline: Everyone with eyes and ears in Hubei Province was trembling with anxiety because of the ominous rumors that had continued without pause. Meanwhile, an exiled imperial relative was planning a luxurious boat ride on Dongting Lake.
hunks.sol: Everyone in Hubei Province with eyes and ears was trembling with anxiety over the grim rumors that refused to die down, yet this exiled imperial relative was planning a lavish boating excursion on Dongting Lake.

hunks.baseline: If Mr. Current Situation heard about this and smashed Ju Wongong’s skull with a sledgehammer, Ju Wongong would have no grounds to complain.
hunks.sol: If Mr. Current Situation heard about this and smashed Ju Wongong’s skull with a sledgehammer, Ju Wongong would have no right to complain.

hunks.baseline: The matter had been settled without too much noise, so I intended to leave without giving it any more thought. But Ju Wongong seemed to see things differently.
hunks.sol: The matter had been settled without too much fuss, so I intended to leave and forget about it. Ju Wongong seemed to take it differently.

hunks.baseline: “I’m a busy man. Why would I go boating on Dongting Lake? What is it?”
hunks.sol: “I’m a busy man. I have more important things to do than go boating on Dongting Lake. Why?”

hunks.baseline: “If I have offended you, I shall apologize once again. In that spirit…”
hunks.sol: “If I have offended you, I shall apologize once again. And in that spirit…”

hunks.baseline: The Qingxia Hall martial artists who had been waiting in advance came forward carrying several ornate sedan chairs positioned among the procession.
hunks.sol: The Qingxia Hall martial artists who had been waiting for his signal carried over one of the ornate sedan chairs positioned throughout the procession.

hunks.baseline: The cloth curtains had not even been lifted, yet a faint fragrance slipped into my nostrils.
hunks.sol: They hadn’t even drawn back its curtains, yet a faint fragrance drifted into my nose.

hunks.baseline: There is an old saying: the thing you say “surely not” about is the thing that gets you. This time was no different.
hunks.sol: There was an old saying that the thing you dismissed with “surely not” was the thing most likely to get you. This time was no different.

hunks.baseline: The moment Ju Wongong finished speaking, the sedan chair’s door slowly opened.
hunks.sol: The moment Ju Wongong spoke, the sedan chair’s door slid open.

hunks.baseline: And then, when a woman carefully stepped down from the sedan chair, a quiet exclamation escaped my lips before I could stop it.
hunks.sol: A woman carefully stepped down, and an exclamation escaped my lips before I could stop it.
“……Whoa.”

hunks.baseline: People often describe celebrities as pretty or handsome.
hunks.sol: People often described celebrities as pretty or handsome.

hunks.baseline: Yes. That was probably the most appropriate word.
hunks.sol: Yes. That was probably the right word.

hunks.baseline: The woman was beautiful enough to make even me gasp in admiration, despite having already guessed Ju Wongong’s intentions.
hunks.sol: She was beautiful enough to draw admiration even from me, despite the fact that I had already guessed Ju Wongong’s intentions.

hunks.baseline: Beautiful enough for Gung Gibang to hurriedly wash his face with spit, for Hyuk Mujin to lose himself in a daze, and for Cheongpung—who had been holding a meat dumpling in one hand and a vegetable dumpling in the other while trying to decide between them—to drop every single dumpling.
hunks.sol: Beautiful enough to make Gung Gibang hurriedly wash his face with spit and Hyuk Mujin stare in a daze. Beautiful enough to make Cheongpung—who had been holding a meat dumpling in one hand and a vegetable dumpling in the other, trying to choose between them—drop them both.

hunks.baseline: Amid the quiet shock flowing through the crowd, Ju Wongong’s voice reached me.
hunks.sol: As the quiet shock rippled through the crowd, Ju Wongong’s voice reached me.

hunks.baseline: “She is the singing courtesan I keep at my side. As you can see, her beauty is worthy of being called the most beautiful in the world. She is also skilled in music, and anyone who hears her play loses himself completely.”
hunks.sol: “She is the singing courtesan I keep at my side. As you can see, her beauty deserves to be called unrivaled beneath the heavens. She is also extraordinarily skilled in music. Anyone who hears her play loses himself completely.”

hunks.baseline: I was not so sure. It seemed as though she could steal a person’s soul without playing a single note.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t so sure she needed the music. She looked capable of stealing a person’s soul without playing a single note.

hunks.baseline: Ju Wongong gave a quiet laugh at the admiration that could not be hidden from my face, then spoke to the woman.
hunks.sol: Ju Wongong laughed quietly at the admiration plain on my face, then turned to the woman.

hunks.baseline: Her red lips slowly opened.
hunks.sol: Her red lips slowly parted.

hunks.baseline: “This humble girl is Honglan. It is my greatest pleasure to meet such an honored guest.”
hunks.sol: “This humble girl is called Honglan. It is my greatest pleasure to meet such an honored guest.”

hunks.baseline: Before the shock of her appearance had even faded, exclamations arose from every direction.
hunks.sol: Before the shock of her appearance had even faded, exclamations burst out from every direction.

hunks.baseline: Honglan. A woman whose name, meaning red orchid, suited her better than anyone.
hunks.sol: Honglan. Red Orchid. The name suited her better than anyone.

hunks.baseline: *Of course, it wasn’t her real name, and she wasn’t an ordinary singing courtesan, either.*
hunks.sol: *Of course, it wasn’t her real name, and she wasn’t an ordinary singing courtesan either.*

hunks.baseline: Like most courtesans, including Wolhwa, Honglan was hiding her real name.
hunks.sol: Like most courtesans, including Wolhwa, Honglan concealed her true name.

hunks.baseline: And unlike Ju Wongong, who did not know even a single martial move or half a stance, she had learned a small amount of martial arts.
hunks.sol: And unlike Ju Wongong, who knew absolutely nothing about martial arts, she had received at least some training.

hunks.baseline: Her slender shoulder twitched at my Sound Transmission, and Honglan gave a slight nod.
hunks.sol: Her slender shoulders twitched at my Sound Transmission. Then Honglan gave the slightest nod.

hunks.baseline: *The Lower District Sect. I had a feeling that was the case.*
hunks.sol: *The Lower District Sect. I had a feeling that was it.*

hunks.baseline: After the Beggars’ Sect, the Lower District Sect possessed more disciples than any other sect.
hunks.sol: The Lower District Sect had more disciples than any organization apart from the Beggars’ Sect.

hunks.baseline: Ju Wongong beside me did not seem to know that, but like the other Lower District Sect courtesans, Honglan had learned enough martial arts to protect herself.
hunks.sol: Ju Wongong didn’t seem aware of it, but like the Lower District Sect’s other courtesans, Honglan had learned enough martial arts to protect herself.

hunks.baseline: “So? What do you think, Great Hero Jin? If you give me the opportunity, this Young Master will treat you properly. Of course, Honglan will sit beside you…”
hunks.sol: “So? What do you think, Great Hero Jin? Give me the opportunity, and this Young Master will treat you properly. Of course, Honglan will sit beside you…”

hunks.baseline: That was written plainly across Ju Wongong’s smug face.
hunks.sol: The words were written plainly across Ju Wongong’s smug face.

hunks.baseline: I stared at Honglan for a moment, then smiled and spoke.
hunks.sol: I gazed at Honglan for a moment, then smiled.

hunks.baseline: “Then we can all move somewhere else together, hm? W-wait. What did you just say?”
hunks.sol: “Then we can all go somewhere else together—hm? W-wait. What did you just say?”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you so flustered? I’m pretty sure I said I had something urgent to do. Is my memory failing me?”
hunks.sol: “Why are you so surprised? I’m pretty sure I already said I had something urgent to do. Is my memory failing me?”

hunks.baseline: I had already wasted time by getting dragged into something pointless. If I were the kind of man who would lose his head over a beautiful woman and follow her somewhere, I would not have survived this long.
hunks.sol: I had already wasted enough time getting dragged into this nonsense. If I were the kind of man who lost his head over a beautiful woman and followed her wherever she went, I wouldn’t have survived this long.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t overdo the partying, either. You’d be better off going home and staying quiet. See you.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t overdo the partying. You’d be better off going home and keeping your head down. See you.”

hunks.baseline: I was about to turn away after that final remark when Ju Wongong held something out to me.
hunks.sol: I was about to turn away when Ju Wongong held something out to me.

hunks.baseline: “Wait! Then at least take this.”
hunks.sol: “Wait! Then at least this.”
